recipes.name: Mom’s Two-Crust Potato Pie Recipe
ingredients_raw: 6 potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
salt and ground black pepper to taste
pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie

steps.text: Place potatoes in a large pot, cover with salted water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain; steam-dry for 1 to 2 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Add ¼ cup butter, ¼ cup milk, salt, and pepper to potatoes; mash until combined. Stir in cheese.
Fit one crust in a 9-inch pie plate; fill with potato mixture. Place remaining pie crust on filling, fold crust edges together, and crimp with a fork to seal.
Combine 2 teaspoons melted butter and 2 teaspoons milk in a small bowl; brush over crust. Cut several vent holes in top crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until crust is golden brown, about 45 minutes; if edges are getting too brown, cover with aluminum foil.

raw_recipe.headline: Mom’s Two-Crust Potato Pie Recipe
raw_recipe.description: This two-crust potato pie recipe is filled with rich, buttery, cheesy mashed potatoes and baked until golden for a hearty and delicious vegetarian meal.

review.reviewBody: I sautéed a white onion and half a red onion added garlic and onion spices (clubhouse) finely chopped carrots, minced red and yellow peppers and 700grams of marble cheddar cheese. I used a sweet potatoe instead also. Everything was heated in a deep skillet and added in order of how I listed. Placed it in a tender flake double pie crust to help save extra time. I basically made a whole new recipe but with guide lines from this one and it was so good the family asked to add it to our favourite meals rotation!! Try it you won't be disappointed and always add in your families favourite veggies finely minced for those picky eaters, the sweetness made it almost like a savery desert I will be making this every month and trying new add in and flavour combos.

I've made this several times, now and my family oves it. It is reminiscent of the potato pie Mom used to make when I was young (I'm 75, now.) I made two changes to the recipe. I chop up an onion and cook it with the potatoes and I use mild Cheddar Cheese, rather than American Cheese.

I love this! I used cheddar instead of American cheese and added bacon. I like that you can add other ingredients without compromising the entire recipe. Even my picky 4-yr-old ate it, which definitely means something. Perfect for a chilly autumn dinner!
Added bacon and green onions to the mashed potatoes. I didn't have cheddar so I used mozzarella cheese - next time I'd like to try it with cheddar.
Tasty. I made mini pies. Easy way to spruce up leftover mashed potatoes. Thanks!
